Calder Transit runs city buses and the Eastfield–Northpoint ferry.

Route 14 is the one people ask about most. Other routes and printed timetables are at the interchange and in the app.

Service information on this site is for Port Calder.

Route 14 is a city bus route serving the harbour side and inland districts.

During Harbor Street roadworks, some Harbor Street stops are being skipped. Riders should allow a little extra time. We apologise for the inconvenience, and for the wind.

A published timetable is available from the interchange and in the app.

Single fares and day tickets are sold on the bus, at the interchange, and in the app.

This page does not take payments. Concession rules follow the city scheme.

Harbor Street stops on Route 14 are still being skipped during roadworks. Please use the nearest open stop and allow extra time.

We are improving the tracker data feed. If a bus appears on the map and does not arrive, treat the printed time as the guide.

Calder Transit is the transit authority for Port Calder. This website has service information for buses and the ferry.

The live map is mentioned in the press. It is not published on this page.

The live map is temporarily unavailable.

Please use printed times, the stop displays, or the app. We are working on the data feed.
